_comment: Model roster for the trustEd eval harness. Prices are USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Anthropic ids/prices from the claude-api skill (cached 2026-06-24). Anthropic cache-read is billed at 0.1x input and cache-write at 1.25x input (standard prompt-caching rate) — the cost helper derives those. OpenAI entries are placeholders: fill model id + verified prices from OpenAI's live pricing page, then set enabled:true to run cross-provider checks. Do NOT trust model names/prices from memory.
